steps.necessaryNow: Establishes departure and safe separation from the carrier.
steps.instruction: Leave the deck and hold a safe climb.

steps.necessaryNow: Teaches the primary vertical flight input before combat.
steps.instruction: Raise the nose to gain altitude.

steps.necessaryNow: Introduces the desired-direction control before the patrol area.
steps.instruction: Hold RIGHT to fly right. Hold the opposite direction later to slow down and turn around.

steps.necessaryNow: Confirms primary fire while hostile aircraft remain held.
steps.instruction: Fire a short burst from the twin 30 mm cannon.

steps.necessaryNow: Lets the player create a lock by flying, rather than reading a targeting manual.
steps.instruction: Approach the marked aircraft and hold it in the targeting circle.

steps.necessaryNow: Pairs a visible lock with the selected secondary-weapon action.
steps.instruction: With LOCK shown, launch the selected AIM-9L.

steps.necessaryNow: Rehearses the defensive action before a live missile warning.
steps.instruction: Release a flare now; use the same control when warned of a missile.

steps.necessaryNow: Introduces nozzle transition before the carrier approach.
steps.instruction: Select VTOL mode and watch the nozzle indicator move.

steps.necessaryNow: Combines the learned controls into the sortie objective.
steps.instruction: Finish the interception, return to Invincible and land gently in VTOL mode.

note: Automated review certifies structure, brevity, timing and placement only. Wording remains provisional until the five human control-concept sessions are reviewed.
